Accessibility fonts bundled here — both under the SIL Open Font License 1.1
(free to use, bundle and redistribute; https://openfontlicense.org).

OpenDyslexic
  A typeface designed to increase readability for readers with dyslexia.
  © Abbie Gonzalez / the OpenDyslexic project. SIL OFL 1.1.
  https://opendyslexic.org · https://github.com/antijingoist/opendyslexic

Atkinson Hyperlegible
  Designed by the Braille Institute for maximum legibility and character
  distinction, especially for low-vision readers.
  © Braille Institute of America, Inc. SIL OFL 1.1.
  https://brailleinstitute.org/freefont

Files obtained via the @fontsource packages (jsDelivr), which repackage the
upstream OFL fonts as woff2. Only the Latin subset is bundled.
